about: Shared golden cases for the number check. The same file must sit in the engine (health-check) and the console (blackcloud-next), and both test suites run every case through checkNumbers(text, dataset). A dataset is a FigureSet: any list left out is empty. expected is pass or fail. unmatched, when given, lists the raw figures that must be reported, in order. Synthetic figures only.

cases.name: exact figures from one finding pass
cases.text: Win rate fell to 18% from 31% across 420 closed deals.

cases.text: Win rate fell to 19% from 31% across 420 closed deals.
